about: Landmark public-domain primary sources and classic literature on Project Gutenberg: philosophy, science, mathematics, economics, politics, psychology, sociology, education, history, law, religion, art, music, and the major novels, plays, epics and poetry.
collected: Nov 2026 from gutenberg.org: Top 100 EBooks lists (yesterday, last 7 and 30 days) at /browse/scores/top; the top ~50 by downloads of ~100 bookshelves and subject categories from /ebooks/bookshelf/ and /ebooks/categories (e.g. Philosophy, Philosophy & Ethics, Science - Physics/Biology/Chemistry, Mathematics, Economics, Politics, Sociology, Psychiatry/Psychology, Teaching & Education, Art, Music, Architecture, Classical Antiquity, Harvard Classics, Best Books Ever, Russian/French/German/British/American Literature, Poetry, Plays, History shelves); plus about 400 named landmark works resolved by title and author in the official catalog index pg_catalog.csv. English editions only, one edition per work. Every book page was fetched to take its title and Copyright status.
